concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑002 (compute cosine similarity between subspace bases of different models) is not referenced in any phase of the implementation plan. The plan’s Phase‑by‑Phase table lists FR‑001, FR‑010, FR‑011, FR‑013, FR‑014, FR‑028 for Phase 1 but omits FR‑002, leaving the requirement unbacked.
Functional Requirement FR‑016 (conduct correlation analyses on at least ten languages) is absent from the plan. No phase lists FR‑016, so the requirement lacks a corresponding implementation task.
